unlisted_practices: Using text-to-image diffusion-generated synthetic images with self- and semi-supervised learning to train detection models when labeled data are scarce, compared with pre-training and fine-tuning on online labeled images

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI computer vision tool for infant suffocation risk using text-to-image synthetic data augmentation, testing the efficacy of synthetic training data compared to conventional training datasets on a clinical validation cohort of 22 infants.

primary.practice: synthetic data generation for model training
